The routine

The Corvelle method

Three steps. Built around how your hair behaves.

  1. Cleanse gently, without stripping the oils your ends need.
  2. Treat once a week with a mask or daily scalp drops.
  3. Style with a cream, serum or mousse matched to your texture.

Behind the storefront

How this store is set up in Shopify

Corvelle is a concept store I designed and built to show day-to-day Shopify merchandising: catalog data, collection rules, promotions, search, QA and accessibility. Here is how each piece maps to a live store.

Catalog & metafields

  • Size variants with SKUs, compare-at pricing and per-variant inventory
  • Metafields: custom.hair_type (list), custom.routine_step, custom.key_ingredients, custom.how_to_use
  • Consistent tags so filters and automated collections behave predictably

Collections & merchandising

  • Automated collections by metafield and tag, with a manual Featured sort for launches
  • Inventory-aware sorting: sold-out drops to the end, low stock gets a badge
  • Seasonal reset: promo bar, sale badges and sets scheduled to start and end

Promotions

  • Automatic discount: free shipping at $50
  • Gift with purchase added at $75 and removed if the cart drops below
  • Minimum-spend code: try FALL15 (15% off $40+)

Search & discovery

  • Synonyms: frizz = smoothing = humidity; dry = hydration = moisture
  • Zero-result searches fall back to best sellers instead of a dead end
  • Boost and bury: best sellers boosted, sold-out buried

Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)

  • Skip link, visible focus, labeled inputs, descriptive alt text
  • Contrast checked in light and dark mode
  • Product and cart drawers trap focus and close with Escape

Launch QA & ops

  • Theme edits made in an unpublished duplicate, previewed, then published
  • Handles and redirects updated when products are renamed or retired
  • GA4 and Microsoft Clarity reviewed for drop-off after each launch

Metafield-driven product details (Liquid section)

{%- comment -%} sections/product-details.liquid {%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign mf = product.metafields.custom -%}
<dl class="mf">
  {%- if mf.routine_step != blank -%}
    <dt>Routine step</dt><dd>{{ mf.routine_step }}</dd>
  {%- endif -%}
  {%- if mf.hair_type != blank -%}
    <dt>Best for</dt>
    <dd>{{ mf.hair_type.value | join: ', ' }}</dd>
  {%- endif -%}
  {%- if section.settings.show_ingredients and mf.key_ingredients != blank -%}
    <dt>Key ingredients</dt>
    <dd>{{ mf.key_ingredients.value | join: ' · ' }}</dd>
  {%- endif -%}
</dl>

{% schema %}
{ "name": "Product details",
  "settings": [
    { "type": "checkbox", "id": "show_ingredients",
      "label": "Show key ingredients", "default": true } ] }
{% endschema %}

Pre-launch QA checklist

  • Every SKU has price, compare-at, weight, alt-texted images and all metafields filled
  • Published to Online Store, Shop app, Google and Meta channels
  • Discounts tested at, below and above each threshold
  • Gift with purchase adds and removes correctly as the cart changes
  • Promo banner, badges and landing page scheduled with an end date
  • Redirects set for renamed handles; no new 404s
  • Theme change previewed on desktop and mobile, regression pass after publish
  • Claims and promo terms match Legal-approved copy
  • Merchant Center and Meta feeds checked for disapprovals the next morning
